title: CRM CUM HOME LOAN MANAGER
description:
**CRM CUM HOME LOAN MANAGER**

**Position:** Loan Coordinator cum CRM Executive

**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala

**Salary:** ₹21000-25,000 per month + Performance-based Incentives

**Age Preference:** 25–40 Years

**Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline

**Experience:** Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Housing Loan Processing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for customers’ home loan applications.
* Assist customers in identifying suitable housing loan options.
* Collect, verify and process customer loan documents.
* Coordinate with bank loan officers for loan eligibility, sanction and disbursement.
* Manage customer booking forms and maintain accurate CRM records.
* Follow up with customers and banks until loan sanction and disbursement.
* Maintain daily sales, loan processing and customer follow-up reports.
* Coordinate with the Sales, Accounts and Project teams.
* Ensure timely completion of customer documentation and registration formalities.

**Required Skills**

* Practical knowledge of Housing Loan Processing.
* Experience in banking / NBFC / Housing Finance Companies.
* Excellent customer handling and follow-up skills.
* Good communication skills in Malayalam and English.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM software.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, SBI, Federal Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, LIC Housing Finance or other reputed banks / housing finance companies are preferred.

Pay: ₹21,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):  
\*   
Have you worked directly with Housing Loan Customers?

* Have you handled CRM or Customer Documentation?

Experience:

* CRM and Home loan : 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Executive (BDE) (Hardware and Construction Industry)
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Business development Executive – is responsible for achieving sales targets in the assigned territory by promoting and selling the company's premium interior hardware products (architectural hardware, bathroom accessories, locks, handles, etc.) to dealers, retailers, builders, contractors, and institutional customers. This role involves fieldwork, relationship building, order generation, collection follow-up, and ensuring customer satisfaction to drive business growth in the region.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Visit customers (shops, dealers, builders, contractors) per route plan to promote products and generate orders.
* Achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets (volume, value, product mix).
* Demonstrate products/catalogues/price lists; appoint/manage new dealers.
* Monitor customer stock, suggest reorders, coordinate supply.
* Follow up collections (ageing reports/tracker); verify field orders/invoices.
* Submit daily sales/visit/collection reports to Area Sales Manager.
* Update customer database, competitor intel, market opportunities.
* Handle enquiries/complaints; escalate repeated issues.
* Participate in review meetings with territory summaries/action plans.
* Maintain route plans, call logs, expense reports.
* Ensure policy compliance (pricing/discounts/credit); support promotions/launches.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate (any discipline); Preferred Master’s degree in Marketing or MBA.
* 1–3 years of experience in field sales, preferably in FMCG, building materials, hardware distribution, or related B2B sectors.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel for basic reporting).
* Strong communication skills in Malayalam and English (essential for customer interactions in Kerala).
* Valid two & four-wheeler driving license and willingness to travel extensively in the allotted market (Within Kerala).

**Key Competencies:**

* Sales Orientation & Target Achievement
* Customer Relationship Management
* Negotiation & Persuasion
* Territory Management & Route Planning
* Follow-Up & Collection Skills
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Proactive Problem-Solving
* Integrity & Ethical Selling

**Others:**

* Travel Allowance and Dearness Allowances are included in the package.
* We are seeking motivated Business Development Executive, to expand our operations across Kerala.
* Openings are available in Kollam, Trivandrum, Kottayam, Idukki, Calicut and Malappuram.
* We're looking for dynamic and result-oriented Business Development Executive to our team across multiple locations.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: On the road
